name: external_xenos_loadlibrary_ac
description: Xenos native-loader delivery of the same synthetic payload as the paired manual-map run. Native loader can use LdrLoadDll; no LoadLibrary thread-start signature is promised. Operator-driven capture; no manipulation section.

extra.provenance: docs/external-cheats/README.md; fill actual tool/game hashes and runtime version before collection.
extra.operator_commands: Launch Xenos.exe, select the printed AC PID, add the SAME x86 TestDll.dll used for synthetic AC captures, choose Native inject in Advanced, and keep thread hijack, unlinking, header erasure and kernel options OFF. Inject once; record Xenos status and independent payload-success evidence. Observe 30 seconds, then press Enter in the capture shell, leaving AC running for cooldown.
extra.success_criterion: Verify intended effect using game state, tool log, or payload marker independently of detector output. Record failed pilots separately.
extra.notes: Fresh AC and the same local bot match per replicate. See docs/external-cheats/evaluation-plan.md. Keep AC alive through cooldown; runner performs final cleanup.
extra.payload_path: Use the x86 TestDll path from your synthetic AC manifest; do not select the x64 build.
